---
title: "EPH Ecosystem — Germán A. Tessmer"
description: "A decade of work with Argentina's Permanent Household Survey (EPH): research on survey redesigns, methodological documentation, open datasets, and applied reports."
---

Since 2015 I have worked continuously with Argentina's *Encuesta Permanente de Hogares* (EPH), the country's main household survey. What began as applied reports at the Observatorio Económico Social UNR evolved into a full open-data infrastructure — a harmonized dataset, estimated series that extend the survey backwards in time, reference documentation, and a research agenda on survey redesigns. Materials are ordered by hierarchy and recency: the most recent work supersedes the earliest reports, which are kept as part of the record.

## Research

- **From Breaks to Bridges: An Architecture for Survey Redesigns That Expand Conceptual Scope** *(with Bárbara Boggiano)* [→ SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6597399){target="_blank"} [→ bridge_eph.R](scripts/bridge_eph.R){download="bridge_eph.R"}
  *Companion script: rebuilds the aggregate variables removed from the raw INDEC user databases by the Q4-2024 redesign, applying the paper's deterministic bridge rules (base R only).*

- **Evolución del premio laboral en Argentina: variaciones para un período corto con información confiable, I trimestre 2017 a II trimestre 2018**
  MA thesis, Maestría en Economía, Universidad de San Andrés, 2019 *(advisor: Walter Sosa Escudero)*. Wage premia by educational attainment estimated with Mincer equations and Heckman selection models on EPH microdata. [→ Repository](https://repositorio.udesa.edu.ar/items/a590dfb4-88ab-416c-91ab-bd855f68aa5d){target="_blank"}

## Data & Documentation

- **Series de datos estimadas de formalidad laboral más allá del empleo asalariado en Argentina a partir de la Encuesta Permanente de Hogares (EPH), 2016-T4 – 2025-T4** *(with Bárbara Boggiano)*
  Universidad Nacional de Rosario, 2026. Quarterly labor formality and informality series (37 quarters) under the expanded 17th ICLS concept, covering all employed workers — including the self-employed — rather than only wage earners, as the historical pension-contribution proxy did. The unobserved span is recovered by backcasting with a post-LASSO logistic model trained on the overlap between the two EPH measurements; the headline series is hybrid (observed where available, calibrated prediction elsewhere), with full traceability of the source of each value. Companion data to *From Breaks to Bridges*, built on the EPH – Observatorio dataset below. [→ Dataset](https://doi.org/10.57715/UNR/L9HKDW){target="_blank"}
  *Contents: individual-quarter microdata for the 4-quarter (canonical) and 5-quarter (robustness) training windows, ready-to-use formality and informality rates by quarter × agglomerate, a full variable dictionary, and an R script that builds the merge key against the raw INDEC user databases. Fixed period, not updated quarterly. CC BY 4.0 — citation required.*

- **EPH – Observatorio. Encuesta Permanente de Hogares de Argentina. Explicada, etiquetada y ampliada** *(with Santiago Moleres & Laureano E. Hess)*
  Universidad Nacional de Rosario, 2024. [→ Dataset](https://doi.org/10.57715/UNR/BL85Z8){target="_blank"} [→ separa_eph.R](scripts/separa_eph.R){download="separa_eph.R"}
  *Companion script: splits each person-level dataset back into its household and individual bases, preserving types, factors, and labels (base R only).*

- **Manual Metodológico EPH – Observatorio**
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2026. Methodological companion to the dataset: documents the Q4-2024 questionnaire redesign, constructed variables, and the methodological breaks relevant for longitudinal analysis. [→ Repository](https://hdl.handle.net/2133/33253){target="_blank"}

- **Diccionario EPH – Observatorio**
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2026. Reference documentation for the processed EPH databases. [→ Repository](https://hdl.handle.net/2133/33195){target="_blank"}

- **Manual EPH – Observatorio** *(with Luciano Jara Musuruana & Patricio Almeida Gentile)*
  Observatorio Económico Social UNR, 2020. First-generation manual for the EPH databases compiled and extended by the Observatorio, superseded by the 2026 documentation. [→ Repository](http://hdl.handle.net/2133/17757){target="_blank"}
